entities.name: Query Expansion
entities.description: A strategy to improve search results by supplementing or refining the original query with additional relevant terms or concepts.

entities.name: Query Decomposition
entities.description: A strategy applied to queries to enrich information for better retrieval.

entities.name: Merging
entities.description: A knowledge enhancement strategy to optimize the retrieval process.

entities.name: Pruning
entities.description: A knowledge enhancement strategy to optimize the retrieval process.

entities.name: Query Rewriting
entities.description: A technique commonly used in RAG but less frequently applied in GraphRAG.

entities.name: Luo et al.
entities.description: Researchers who generate relation paths grounded by KGs with LLMs to enhance retrieval queries.

entities.name: Cheng et al.
entities.description: Researchers who adopt SPARQL to get aliases of query entities from Wikidata.

entities.name: Huang et al.
entities.description: Researchers who propose a consensus-view knowledge retrieval method.

entities.name: HyKGE
entities.description: A method that utilizes a large model to generate hypothesis output of the question to enhance retrieval.

entities.name: Wikidata
entities.description: A knowledge graph used to retrieve aliases of query entities.

entities.name: SPARQL
entities.description: A query language used to retrieve aliases from Wikidata.

entities.name: Consensus-view knowledge retrieval
entities.description: A method proposed by Huang et al. that discovers semantically relevant queries and re-weights original query terms.

entities.name: J. ACM
entities.description: The journal where the survey article was published.

relationships.description: Cheng et al. use Wikidata to get aliases of query entities.
Cheng et al. adopt SPARQL to retrieve data from Wikidata.
Huang et al. propose the consensus-view knowledge retrieval method.
The method involves discovering semantically relevant queries and re-weighting terms, which aligns with query enhancement/expansion strategies.
HyKGE enhances the query by concatenating hypothesis output with the original query.
Luo et al. enhance the retrieval query by generating relation paths.
